recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only under a new work-group issue if broader transaction semantics for operations or non-base endpoints need clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-16920 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for the STU3 Bundle/Feed artifact. It asked for brief Bundle-page guidance about special considerations when writing to the /Bundle endpoint rather than the RESTful base address.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn revision 14407, now commit 194adcb3902ba5dc3c5e2d8192e61069b2225924, which added the Bundle page section "Serving Bundles using the RESTful API" to source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml.
additional_context: Bundle remains an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and the HTTP page separately defines batch/transaction processing as POST [base]. Later Zulip and Confluence searches found discussion consistent with the same base-vs-/Bundle distinction and no conflicting final decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml already says that a batch, transaction, or message POSTed to /Bundle is stored as a Bundle resource and is not processed as those interaction types.
